column1: # Ceilings for files already past the 800-line limit in file_size.rs.
# One `path<TAB>lines` row per counted source file. The gate fails when a file
# grows past its ceiling, so lowering a number here is how a file that shrinks
# keeps the ground it gained. Raising one is a reviewed decision: a file that
# needs more room is usually a file that needs a module.
# Generated from the tree at the commit that added the gate; regenerate with
# `cargo xtask check file-size` and the file list it prints.
